predicaments.basis: The Oms reach the moon and destroy statues the Draags require for the meditation ritual that reproduces their species, and the planet-wide purge stops within hours.

relatives.title: Planet of the Apes
relatives.shares: humans held as animals by a species that considers speech and literacy proof they are not

relatives.title: Spartacus
relatives.shares: a slave educated inside the master's house who takes that education back to the ones outside

relatives.title: Never Let Me Go
relatives.shares: people raised with genuine tenderness by those who will not let them stop being property

relatives.title: Chi-Raq
relatives.shares: the powerless win by seizing the one thing the powerful cannot do without

relatives.title: District 9
relatives.shares: a segregated species tolerated as vermin until it gets hold of the technology of the rulers

films.title: The Touch
films.engine: A doctor's wife whose mother has just died takes a foreign lover who saw her crying at the clinic, and gets from him a life that is by turns adoring, distant and violent. Her husband finds out by anonymous letter and tells her that if she goes she cannot come back; she goes, discovers the lover has lied about having no family and is held by the sister he hid, and when he finally offers to take her and her children away she refuses and calls it duty.

predicaments.situation: a third person enters a settled couple
predicaments.basis: Karin, married to Andreas with two children, begins her first affair with David, the archaeologist they invited to dinner.

predicaments.situation: the one offering love also deals the blows
predicaments.basis: David declares he fell in love with her the day he saw her grieving, and is by turns distant, overbearing and angry, slapping her when she arrives drunk and still smoking.

predicaments.situation: one is told leaving cannot be undone
predicaments.basis: Andreas, having received poison pen letters about the affair, tells Karin sternly that if she goes after David she cannot return to the marriage; she goes.

predicaments.situation: a hidden relative is discovered by the lover
predicaments.basis: At his London address Karin meets Sara, who says she is David's sister though he had told Karin his family were all dead, and who declares he will never leave her.

predicaments.situation: duty is chosen over the one wanted
predicaments.basis: David finally says life without her is intolerable and asks her to bring the children to Denmark; she refuses, citing duty, and he calls it lying and cowardice.

relatives.title: Brief Encounter
relatives.shares: a settled wife's one great attachment ended by her own invocation of duty

relatives.title: The Bridges of Madison County
relatives.shares: a mother offered a life with the man who wants her and turning it down for the family already there

relatives.title: Une femme mariée
relatives.shares: a wife divided between a husband and a lover, unable to say which she is carrying

relatives.title: Last Tango in Paris
relatives.shares: an affair begun in fresh grief with a man whose tenderness alternates with cruelty

relatives.title: Nora
relatives.shares: a wife told that if she walks out the door it does not open again

films.title: The Oldest Profession
films.engine: Six episodes strung from cave-dwellers to a future spaceport, each one about a woman selling her company and the arrangement being bent by something the money cannot settle: the wife who turns up as the stranger her husband paid for, the client who vanishes before the estate is settled, the woman who tears up the banknotes and takes the man instead, the traveller who wants talk before anything else.

predicaments.situation: intimacy is exchanged for payment
predicaments.basis: The through-line of every episode, from Brit painting her face to attract a passing trader to Marlène and Eléonore being offered to a visitor at the spaceport hotel.

roles.paying: the traders, emperors, clients and travellers
roles.paid: Brit, Mimi, Nini, Catherine, Marlène, Eléonore

predicaments.situation: a spouse appears to the other in disguise
predicaments.basis: Emperor Flavius invents an excuse to leave Domitilla for a brothel and the mysterious beauty he finds there turns out to be the Empress herself.

predicaments.situation: a promise of payment is never kept
predicaments.basis: Philibert watches an old aristocrat guillotined from Mimi's window, calls him his childless uncle, promises to pay once the lawyers settle the estate, and disappears.

predicaments.situation: the one paid refuses the payment
predicaments.basis: Nini finds from his wallet that the lonely old man asleep beside her is a partner in a major bank, takes nothing, tells him she loves him, and ends up married.

predicaments.situation: someone is rejected for being unable to speak
predicaments.basis: The traveller from the space outpost sends Marlène away because she cannot hold a conversation, and takes Eléonore, who talks beautifully but will go no further.

relatives.title: Nights of Cabiria
relatives.shares: a woman who sells her company and is undone by wanting to be loved instead of paid

relatives.title: Belle de Jour
relatives.shares: the purchase of a woman's afternoons colliding with the marriage running alongside it

relatives.title: Vivre sa vie
relatives.shares: episodes tracking a woman into the trade, with talk mattering more than the transaction

relatives.title: Marriage Italian Style
relatives.shares: a paid arrangement converted into a marriage by the woman's own manoeuvre

relatives.title: Le Plaisir
relatives.shares: an anthology in which each purchased pleasure turns on something money cannot cover

films.title: La Chinoise
films.engine: Five young people borrow a rich family's apartment and turn it into a cell where revolution is something you lecture about, cook for and paint on the walls. One is expelled for disagreeing, one shoots himself, and the one who finally acts kills the wrong man on the way to killing the right one. When they leave, the owners come back and put the room the way it was.

predicaments.situation: the discontented talk instead of acting
predicaments.basis: The cell fills its days with Marxist readings, lectures to one another and slogans painted on borrowed walls, and its revolutionary activities come to nothing.

predicaments.situation: a member is cast out for dissenting
predicaments.basis: Henri argues the pro-Soviet line against the group's taste for violence and is denounced as a revisionist and expelled from the cell.

predicaments.situation: the one who serves is excluded
predicaments.basis: Yvonne does the household chores and is kept at the edge of the lectures and discussions, performing skits for the others rather than speaking as one of them.

predicaments.situation: the young live off what they denounce
predicaments.basis: The cell operates out of a lavish apartment lent by one member's wealthy parents, who return at the end to tear down the posters and clear the shelves.

predicaments.situation: a stranger is killed by mistake
predicaments.basis: Véronique reverses the digits of the hotel room number and shoots the wrong man before going back to kill Sholokhov.

predicaments.situation: a warning goes unheeded
predicaments.basis: On the train Francis Jeanson argues against violence as a way to shut the universities, and Véronique goes on to the hotel anyway.

relatives.title: Night and Fog in Japan
relatives.shares: a student left group turns its energy inward and expels one of its own for deviation

relatives.title: The Third Generation
relatives.shares: comfortable young people play at armed revolt from a borrowed bourgeois interior

relatives.title: Ashes and Diamonds
relatives.shares: an assassin kills the wrong man first and then goes back to finish the job

relatives.title: Zabriskie Point
relatives.shares: students talk revolution until one of them acts alone and the act lands on nobody

relatives.title: The Devil, Probably
relatives.shares: a young man's despair ends in his own death inside a circle that only ever talked

films.title: Mother Küsters' Trip to Heaven
films.engine: A factory worker kills a man and himself after hearing the layoffs announced, and his widow wants him understood rather than reported. Everyone who takes an interest — reporters, her children, a party, then a smaller group with guns — turns out to want her husband for their own purposes, and she is passed from hand to hand until she is either shot or taken to dinner by a stranger.

predicaments.situation: a death is claimed as another's cause
predicaments.basis: The Communists present Hermann as a revolutionary and a victim of capitalism, though he himself thought communists were troublemakers, and the anarchists then claim his name for their own action.

roles.claiming: the Thälmanns and later Knab's group
roles.claimed: Hermann Küsters and his widow Emma

predicaments.situation: a private grief is made public property
predicaments.basis: Reporters descend on Emma to sensationalize the killing and suicide, and Niemeyer's magazine piece on the family appears against her wishes.

predicaments.situation: one person's ruin is another's livelihood
predicaments.basis: Corinna defends Niemeyer's article about her own father's death on the grounds that he is earning a living, while she is sleeping with him.

predicaments.situation: kin are absent when they are most needed
predicaments.basis: Ernst and Helene go on holiday straight after the deaths and on returning announce they are setting up on their own, and Corinna leaves to pursue her singing and Niemeyer.

predicaments.situation: help is offered for the helper's own ends
predicaments.basis: The Thälmanns introduce themselves at the funeral and bring Emma home, then explain that clearing Hermann's name must wait for the election campaign.

predicaments.situation: what was owed to the dead is denied
predicaments.basis: At the factory Emma learns the company pension will not apply to her, with the workers' council and the board of one mind about it.

relatives.title: The Lost Honour of Katharina Blum
relatives.shares: a magazine takes a private catastrophe and prints it as something the family cannot recognise

relatives.title: Ace in the Hole
relatives.shares: a reporter builds a career on a family's disaster and keeps it going as long as it sells

relatives.title: Tokyo Story
relatives.shares: grown children are elsewhere and busy at exactly the moment a parent is left alone

relatives.title: Umberto D.
relatives.shares: an old person discovers that what was owed for a lifetime of work will not be paid

relatives.title: Salvatore Giuliano
relatives.shares: a dead man is claimed after the fact by parties who each need him to have meant something different

films.title: A Quiet Place in the Country
films.engine: A painter who has stopped painting moves into a decayed villa and becomes absorbed in a young woman who was shot there during the war, digging through her lovers and her mother's keepsakes. The living woman who manages him and sells his work is frightened out of the house and then, in the version he believes, murdered by him. He ends confined and painting again, while she quietly buys the results.

predicaments.situation: a living partner is displaced by the dead
predicaments.basis: Leonardo's absorption in Wanda — her photographs, her lovers, her death — takes over the villa, and Flavia is injured, terrified and finally driven out of it.

predicaments.situation: help is offered for the helper's own ends
predicaments.basis: Flavia presses Leonardo to paint so her gallery has work to sell, and at the end the asylum orderly presses him the same way, supplying magazines for inspiration.

predicaments.situation: a private grief is made public property
predicaments.basis: Leonardo questions the butcher and the locals about Wanda's affairs and passes himself off as a journalist to her destitute mother in Venice, stealing photographs from her.

predicaments.situation: one who worships kills the thing worshipped
predicaments.basis: Attilio, who has laid flowers at the wall where Wanda died for years, finally admits she survived the airstrike and that he shot her himself.

predicaments.situation: the closest companion becomes the victim
predicaments.basis: After the séance Leonardo pursues Flavia through the villa with a knife and a shovel, though she is later seen alive among the police outside.

predicaments.situation: one person's ruin is another's livelihood
predicaments.basis: Locked up and painting small obscene canvases, Leonardo does not know that Flavia is buying them from the orderly to hang in her gallery.

relatives.title: Vertigo
relatives.shares: a man's fixation on a dead woman consumes the living woman in front of him

relatives.title: Rebecca
relatives.shares: a dead woman still governs the house and the living one cannot hold her ground in it

relatives.title: Ugetsu
relatives.shares: a man is drawn to a noblewoman who is not alive and abandons the woman who sustains him

relatives.title: Laura
relatives.shares: an investigator falls for the dead woman he is reconstructing out of other people's accounts

relatives.title: Camille Claudel
relatives.shares: an artist ends confined while the work goes on being sold by the person who managed them

films.title: Martha
films.engine: A woman who has spent thirty-one years under a father who would not be touched loses him in one afternoon and is handed to a man who insults her on their first walk and is rewarded with a kiss. He removes her job, her mother, her telephone and her friends, and is aroused by her pain; when she finally runs, the flight kills the man helping her and paralyses her, and she is wheeled out of the hospital by her husband.

predicaments.situation: one person takes charge of another's whole life
predicaments.basis: Without consulting her, Helmut ends Martha's job, moves her out of her home, changes her music and reading, cuts off the telephone and stops her leaving the house.

predicaments.situation: cruelty is received as love
predicaments.basis: Helmut lists Martha's physical shortcomings and she accepts them as fact and kisses him; he proposes after making her ride the roller coaster until she vomits and she gratefully accepts.

predicaments.situation: a rival is removed to secure possession
predicaments.basis: When Martha's mother collapses after an overdose at news of the engagement, Helmut uses the moment to have her institutionalized.

predicaments.situation: a parent blames the child for a death
predicaments.basis: Back in Constance, Martha's mother receives her badly and holds her responsible for the father's heart attack in Rome, taking to drink and pills.

predicaments.situation: the one asked for help gives none
predicaments.basis: Martha tries to describe Helmut's behaviour to her friend Marianne and cannot, and Marianne is no use in any case.

predicaments.situation: an attempt at escape tightens the bond
predicaments.basis: Fleeing what she takes to be a plan to kill her, Martha grabs the wheel of Kaiser's car; he dies, she is paralysed from the waist down, and Helmut collects her from the hospital.

relatives.title: Gaslight
relatives.shares: a husband methodically cuts a wife off from the world and from her own judgement

relatives.title: Secret Beyond the Door
relatives.shares: a woman marries quickly into a house where she comes to believe her husband means to kill her

relatives.title: The Piano Teacher
relatives.shares: pain is sought and offered as the currency of love between two people

relatives.title: Woman in the Dunes
relatives.shares: every attempt to get out of the confinement ends by fitting the person more tightly into it

relatives.title: A Woman Under the Influence
relatives.shares: a woman is committed by the family member who claims to be acting for her

films.title: Such a Gorgeous Kid Like Me
films.engine: A man writing about criminal women interviews one in prison, believes her account, falls for her and hunts down the film footage that frees her. She goes on to a singing career, kills her husband when he catches them together, and leaves the gun on her unconscious admirer; he sweeps a prison yard while the woman who warned him about her finishes his book.

predicaments.situation: the one studying is captured by the studied
predicaments.basis: Stanislas comes to Camille's cell to gather material for a thesis on criminal women, falls in love with his subject, and sets about proving her innocent instead.

predicaments.situation: a warning goes unheeded
predicaments.basis: His secretary tells him plainly that Camille is a manipulative slut and he cannot be convinced, even while she helps him find the boy's footage.

predicaments.situation: the freed one destroys the liberator
predicaments.basis: Camille, released on the evidence Stanislas dug up, later seduces him, kills her husband over it and plants the gun on him while he is passed out.

predicaments.situation: one person is punished for another's crime
predicaments.basis: Camille shoots her husband and Stanislas goes to prison for the murder, with no help from her.

predicaments.situation: one person's ruin is another's livelihood
predicaments.basis: With Stanislas in the yard below, his secretary types up the thesis he began, this time as an exposure of Camille.

relatives.title: Body Heat
relatives.shares: a man is used to secure a woman's freedom and goes to prison while she goes free

relatives.title: The Last Seduction
relatives.shares: a woman lets the man who helped her take the charge for a killing she committed

relatives.title: Pandora's Box
relatives.shares: everyone who takes it upon themselves to rescue her is ruined by the rescue

relatives.title: The Silence of the Lambs
relatives.shares: an interviewer builds a career on a prisoner's account and is steered by it

relatives.title: Double Indemnity
relatives.shares: a professional believes the woman's version of events and is fitted for the consequences

films.title: I maniaci
films.engine: Thirteen short sketches in which someone is ruled by a single fixation — comfort, precedence, appearances, suspicion, decorum — and the bill is paid by whoever happens to be beside them: a wife put out on the street over a bet, a driver who will not be passed, a novice writer invited to confess and then humiliated for it.

predicaments.situation: neighbours ruin themselves to outdo each other
predicaments.basis: In La cambiale two middle-class couples compete over appearing the wealthier and sink deeper into debt doing it.

predicaments.situation: a secret becomes a hold over someone
predicaments.basis: In Lo sport an employee discovers that his bullying manager lost a bet and put his own wife out on the street, and uses the knowledge against him.

predicaments.situation: an invitation to confess becomes a trap
predicaments.basis: In La parolaccia an established writer advises a struggling novelist to dredge up his most depraved fantasies, then humiliates him with them before a literary society.

predicaments.situation: two strangers grow hostile without cause
predicaments.basis: In L'autostop a poor southern worker takes a lift from a Milanese businessman and, though neither does anything wrong, both slide into suspicion and hostility.

predicaments.situation: each partner hides the same secret
predicaments.basis: In the closing segment thieves find the empty mansion busy, with husband and wife separately creeping back in from evenings with their lovers.

predicaments.situation: the discontented talk instead of acting
predicaments.basis: In La protesta two friends in two different historical periods voice their dissatisfaction with how things are and never once attempt to change anything.

relatives.title: I mostri
relatives.shares: a sequence of short episodes where a private compulsion becomes cruelty toward whoever is nearest

relatives.title: Il Boom
relatives.shares: a man wrecks himself to keep up an appearance of wealth in front of his set

relatives.title: Duel
relatives.shares: two strangers on the road escalate into mutual hostility on no real provocation

relatives.title: The Rules of the Game
relatives.shares: a household where each partner is separately concealing a lover and everyone keeps the form intact

relatives.title: Dr. Strangelove
relatives.shares: people ruled by a single fixation carry it through to its cost on everyone in the room

films.title: Viva Maria!
films.engine: An orphaned girl who learned to make bombs with her father and a stage performer whose partner has just killed himself fall in together, and each keeps picking up what someone else set down — a dead man's explosives, a dying man's promise. What starts as two women covering each other's losses ends with them carrying a whole country's revolt, worshipped by strangers who need them to be holy, feared by the powerful for exactly that.

predicaments.situation: two survivors of separate losses pair up
predicaments.basis: Maria II, whose father is killed blowing up a bridge, hides in the wagon of Maria I, whose stage partner has just committed suicide over a failed romance, and the two form an act together.

predicaments.situation: a dying man extracts a promise
predicaments.basis: Shot escaping Rodríguez's hacienda, the revolutionary Florès makes Maria I swear on his deathbed to carry on his cause, and she does.

predicaments.situation: a cause is taken up out of friendship
predicaments.basis: Maria II wants no part of the revolution until Maria I leads her men into an ambush, whereupon she uses her bombmaking to save them and stays.

predicaments.situation: the strong take from the weak by force
predicaments.basis: Rodríguez's henchmen ransack a village, murder and enslave its people, and jail the travelling troupe alongside them.

predicaments.situation: those who lead are worshipped as holy
predicaments.basis: The peasants venerate the two Marias like saints, which the dictator and the Catholic authorities read as sacrilege and answer with capture and an attempted torture.

predicaments.situation: an ordeal is replayed for an audience
predicaments.basis: Back in France the troupe stages the revolution as a Spanish-language musical, the Marias performing themselves in black wigs.

relatives.title: The Battle of Algiers
relatives.shares: a fighter's death binds those left behind to carry the fight on

relatives.title: Antonio das Mortes
relatives.shares: a peasant revolt against a landowner turns its leaders into sacred figures

relatives.title: Two Mules for Sister Sara
relatives.shares: two strangers thrown together end up serving a revolution neither sought

relatives.title: Seven Samurai
relatives.shares: outsiders take up a village's fight against those who take by force

relatives.title: Duck, You Sucker
relatives.shares: a maker of explosives is drawn by loyalty into another man's cause

films.title: Sympathy for the Devil
films.engine: A band works one song over and over in a studio while one of its own quietly comes apart, and elsewhere people walk into a shop, buy something, are handed a piece of paper, and use it to slap two bound captives on their way out, a child brought in to do the same. A woman followed by a camera crew is permitted only yes or no. What the film keeps putting in front of you is how casually harm gets administered by people just passing through, and how little the patient making of anything touches it.

predicaments.situation: people pay for the right to strike another
predicaments.basis: In the pornographic bookstore, each customer exchanges purchases for a sheet of paper, slaps the faces of two Maoist hostages sitting patiently by a display, gives a Nazi salute, and leaves.

predicaments.situation: a child is taught to repeat adult cruelty
predicaments.basis: Toward the end of the bookstore scene a small child is admitted to buy a pamphlet and slap the hostages' faces like the adults before him.

roles.teaching: the customers and the shop owner

predicaments.situation: a person may answer only yes or no
predicaments.basis: A camera crew follows a woman in a yellow peasant dress through open country asking questions she can only answer yes or no; a chapter heading names her Eve Democracy.

predicaments.situation: one of a group slips away from it
predicaments.basis: Across the long studio takes of the Rolling Stones building the song, Brian Jones's dissolution is shown while the others keep recording and re-recording.

relatives.title: The Act of Killing
relatives.shares: people who administered atrocity restage it calmly and casually for a camera

relatives.title: Salò, or the 120 Days of Sodom
relatives.shares: cruelty to captives is carried out as unhurried routine before onlookers

relatives.title: Come and See
relatives.shares: a child is drawn into doing what the adults around him do

relatives.title: Chronicle of a Summer
relatives.shares: people are followed by a crew and answer its questions on camera

relatives.title: Funny Games
relatives.shares: harm is administered politely and transactionally, with the audience implicated

films.title: Seemabaddha
films.engine: A sales manager who is close to the top finds that an export order of fans has been painted wrong, and rather than take the blame he has a strike faked at his own factory — a watchman badly injured, a riot staged — so the delay counts as civil disturbance. He gets the promotion. The person watching all this is his sister-in-law, who has admired him since he was her father's student and who secretly envies her sister the marriage; the film is about what it costs him to be seen by her doing it.

predicaments.situation: harm is done to strangers to protect oneself
predicaments.basis: To escape blame for the defective consignment, Shyamal and the labour officer provoke a strike: a factory watchman is badly injured, a false riot is organised, a lock-out declared, and strikebreakers make the repairs.

roles.harmed: the watchman and the factory workers

predicaments.situation: an admirer sees through the one admired
predicaments.basis: Tutul, who admired Shyamal's idealism from her days as his teacher's daughter, understands what the strike was and how he was promoted for it, and he falls in her eyes and his own.

predicaments.situation: a guest envies the life they are shown
predicaments.basis: Tutul arrives from Patna and is toured through the restaurants, clubs, beauty parlours and race courses of her sister's marriage, envying it in secret.

relatives.title: The Apartment
relatives.shares: a man rises by an arrangement he cannot square with the one whose regard he wants

relatives.title: Sweet Smell of Success
relatives.shares: a man injures people he barely knows to protect his own standing

relatives.title: The Human Condition: No Greater Love
relatives.shares: a manager's compromise with the system above him lands on the workers below

relatives.title: Blue Collar
relatives.shares: workers are hurt by manoeuvres decided far above them

relatives.title: Wall Street
relatives.shares: the promotion arrives and the good opinion that mattered is gone

films.title: The Cat o' Nine Tails
films.engine: A researcher who learned from his own institute's study that he carries the chromosome it calls criminal breaks in to swap the record, and then kills every person who gets near knowing it — the colleague who tries to sell him the secret, the photographer, the fiancée with a note in her locket. Ranged against him are a blind former reporter who has to borrow other people's eyes and a working journalist who lends them. It ends with the blind man told a lie about the girl he raised and killing on the strength of it.

predicaments.situation: harm is done to strangers to protect oneself
predicaments.basis: Casoni kills Calabresi, the photographer, Bianca and Braun, and attempts Carlo and Franco, to keep anyone from learning he tested positive and swapped his records.

roles.harmed: Calabresi, the photographer, Bianca and Braun

predicaments.situation: a secret is sold back to its owner
predicaments.basis: Calabresi tells his fiancée he knows who broke into the Institute and why, tries to blackmail the man, and is pushed in front of an arriving train.

predicaments.situation: one person must see for another
predicaments.basis: Franco, blind, works the case through Lori's noticing Bianca fiddling with her locket and through Carlo's reading of the cropped newspaper photograph.

predicaments.situation: the living will not leave the dead alone
predicaments.basis: Deducing the note is inside the locket Bianca was buried wearing, Franco and Carlo open her coffin in the family crypt, and the killer traps them there.

predicaments.situation: a lie about a death provokes a killing
predicaments.basis: Cornered on the roof, Casoni tells Franco he has killed Lori; Franco knocks him through a skylight down an elevator shaft as the living Lori calls out for him.

predicaments.situation: a person is condemned by others from birth
predicaments.basis: The Institute's XYY study holds that people born with that chromosome have a criminal tendency, and one doctor proposes testing for it as crime prevention; Casoni, who tested positive, breaks in to destroy the finding.

relatives.title: Vertigo
relatives.shares: a man is made to act by a lie told about a woman's death

relatives.title: Wait Until Dark
relatives.shares: a blind person must work through other people's senses against someone who means to kill

relatives.title: Blow-Up
relatives.shares: a photograph holds the proof, and the one it would expose comes for it

relatives.title: Blow Out
relatives.shares: every trace of the evidence is destroyed and its witnesses hunted

relatives.title: Rear Window
relatives.shares: an immobilised watcher depends on others to go and look for him

films.title: The Phantom of Liberty
films.engine: Handed along a chain of strangers who each pass the film to the next, people keep insisting on what is plainly in front of them — a letter from a postman who came in the night, a daughter standing right there in the room, one's own name and position — and are calmly, courteously told by everyone else that it is not so. Meanwhile what is forbidden and what is permitted keep swapping places: a man who shot strangers from a tower walks out of the courtroom fêted, dinner guests sit on toilets and eat alone in a small room, guests flee a whipping done in front of them.

predicaments.situation: what someone plainly sees is denied by everyone
predicaments.basis: A doctor calls the nocturnal visitations dreams though Foucauld holds the postman's letter; the Legendres' daughter is reported missing while standing beside them and no one at school or the police station acknowledges her; officers refuse to believe the Prefect of Police is who he says.

roles.denying: the doctors, the school, the police

predicaments.situation: the living will not leave the dead alone
predicaments.basis: A French captain exhumes a noblewoman's corpse and finds her face intact; centuries later a police chief takes a call from his dead sister and finds a telephone beside her coffin, and is arrested for desecration.

predicaments.situation: two people of the same family become lovers
predicaments.basis: A young man and his elderly aunt check into the inn to consummate an affair; she refuses him, he leaves the room, and on his return she has agreed.

predicaments.situation: one who kills is celebrated by the onlookers
predicaments.basis: A sniper shoots people at random from the Tour Montparnasse, is arrested, tried and sentenced to death, then walks out of the courtroom and is treated like a celebrity.

predicaments.situation: what some do openly others must hide
predicaments.basis: The professor recounts a dinner party where guests sat around the table on flushing toilets, and at the inn a hatter is whipped in bottomless trousers in front of guests who are shocked and leave.

predicaments.situation: someone finds another man in his place
predicaments.basis: Brought to his own office, the Prefect finds a different man holding his post; the two greet each other cordially as acquaintances and go on to direct the same riot together.

relatives.title: Bunny Lake Is Missing
relatives.shares: a parent insists on a child everyone else says was never there

relatives.title: The Trial
relatives.shares: a man's account of who he is is calmly disbelieved by courteous officials

relatives.title: The Double
relatives.shares: another man occupies one's own place and everyone treats it as normal

relatives.title: Ugetsu
relatives.shares: the dead keep company with the living and are sought out by them

relatives.title: Natural Born Killers
relatives.shares: someone who killed strangers is turned into a figure the public adores

films.title: Joy of Learning
films.engine: Two students meet seven times over four years in a black void to take sound and image apart, guided by a whispering voice that never shows itself and speaks past them to whoever is watching. Whatever is growing between them is never allowed to become the romance the form would ordinarily give it, and at the end the actors playing them step out of their parts and the void turns out to be a television studio.

predicaments.situation: two people meet for years without becoming lovers
predicaments.basis: Patricia and Emile meet seven times over four years and a close relationship is suggested, but nothing is given that would mark it as a romance.

predicaments.situation: someone is instructed by a voice never seen
predicaments.basis: Godard is present only as a whispered voice-over paired with electronic sounds, addressing the two students and the viewer alike.

predicaments.situation: those playing a part step out of it
predicaments.basis: Towards the end the actors drop their characters, and the black void the pair have been meeting in is revealed as a TV studio.

relatives.title: In the Mood for Love
relatives.shares: two people meet again and again over years and never become lovers

relatives.title: Persona
relatives.shares: two figures in a bare space, close without romance, until the apparatus shows itself

relatives.title: Sans Soleil
relatives.shares: an unseen voice teaches over images the viewer is not always shown

relatives.title: Man with a Movie Camera
relatives.shares: a film takes itself apart to show how images and sounds are made

relatives.title: Symbiopsychotaxiplasm: Take One
relatives.shares: the actors break their parts and the crew and studio become the subject

films.title: Casanova 70
films.engine: Andrea can only want a woman when the having of her might kill him, so anything safely offered goes dead in his hands and anything ruinous is irresistible. Advised to look for the soul rather than the body, he tries it with a woman he genuinely loves and discovers that loving her is exactly what makes him unable to touch her. He is eventually acquitted, married, and unchanged.

predicaments.situation: a man can love only under threat
predicaments.basis: Andrea's arousal depends on physical danger — a girlfriend aiming a gun at him, a kiss taken inside a cage of lions, the bed of a superior officer's wife, a seduction under the eyes of a family that will kill him for it.

predicaments.situation: a promise of marriage is broken on impulse
predicaments.basis: The night before his wedding to Gigliola he accepts a lion tamer's public dare to kiss her among the lions, and the engagement ends there.

predicaments.situation: a woman offers herself to save a man
predicaments.basis: Hearing what is wrong with him, Gigliola offers to give herself to Andrea if it will stop him chasing other women, and he goes instead to a woman said to bring ruin on her lovers.

predicaments.situation: a plot to kill turns on its plotter
predicaments.basis: A countess recruits Andrea to drop a balanced stone ball on her supposedly deaf husband; the husband has heard everything, rigs the seat for Andrea, and is killed by it himself when Andrea slams a door.

predicaments.situation: a man is judged by everyone he wronged
predicaments.basis: At his murder trial the women he passed through are called to describe him, the doctor he consulted breaks down on the stand, and only Gigliola speaks for him.

predicaments.situation: a man returns to the love he lost
predicaments.basis: After the affairs collapse he goes back to his hometown and to Gigliola, hoping her love will cure what nothing else has.

relatives.title: Belle de Jour
relatives.shares: desire that only functions under danger and degradation, and dies in safety

relatives.title: That Obscure Object of Desire
relatives.shares: a man whose wanting is structurally unable to arrive at the woman he loves

relatives.title: Divorce Italian Style
relatives.shares: a plotted spousal death arranged for a lover, and a courtroom that turns on it

relatives.title: The Postman Always Rings Twice
relatives.shares: lovers scheming a husband's death by an accident that recoils on them

relatives.title: Punch-Drunk Love
relatives.shares: a man who can only reach intimacy by way of situations that endanger him

films.title: The Working Class Goes to Heaven
films.engine: Lulù is the fastest man on the line, which is why management quotes his output at everyone else and why his colleagues can't stand him. A lost finger flips him overnight into the militant he used to sneer at — and then each side in turn, union, students, the woman he lives with, keeps him only as long as he is useful to it. The factory takes him back on exactly the terms he rebelled against.

predicaments.situation: a man is hated for serving those above
predicaments.basis: Lulù's piecework speed is used by the factory management to justify higher output quotas, so his fellow workers despise him.

predicaments.situation: an injury turns a man against his life
predicaments.basis: Losing a finger in an accident on the machine reverses Lulù's whole attitude to the work he had been proud of.

predicaments.situation: a convert is refused by his new cause
predicaments.basis: After being fired for agitating, Lulù goes to the students at the gates whose slogans he adopted, and they tell him he is of no use to them because he is an individual case.

predicaments.situation: a man's change drives his partner away
predicaments.basis: When Lulù takes up with a woman at the plant and moves the students into the flat, Lidia leaves with her son.

predicaments.situation: a man tends someone broken before him
predicaments.basis: Lulù regularly visits Militina, a former colleague committed to an institution after the conditions broke him, who talks of breaking through a wall.

predicaments.situation: a man is returned to what he fled
predicaments.basis: The union negotiates his reinstatement and he ends back on the assembly line, half-aware of it, telling his colleagues a dream of breaking the wall and coming out of fog.

relatives.title: Modern Times
relatives.shares: a man whose body is consumed by the line and who is put back on it

relatives.title: Blue Collar
relatives.shares: a worker crushed between the union and the management, useful to both, kept by neither

relatives.title: Man of Marble
relatives.shares: a record-breaking worker held up as a model, then discarded when he stops being convenient

relatives.title: Norma Rae
relatives.shares: a worker converted to militancy and made unwelcome on every side

relatives.title: Tout va bien
relatives.shares: a factory occupation in which the militants and the workers do not want the same thing

films.title: Lucky Luciano
films.engine: Luciano runs a narcotics operation entirely through other men's hands, so the men who carry it out can be arrested and he cannot. The agent assigned to him spends years getting close enough to touch him, and is stopped by his own superiors rather than by Luciano. Between them stands an informer whom one side leaves to rot and the other side kills.

predicaments.situation: a captive buys freedom by serving his captors
predicaments.basis: Imprisoned in the United States, Luciano offers his services to military intelligence during the war, gets a commutation from Governor Dewey, and is deported to Italy.

predicaments.situation: a man acts only through other hands
predicaments.basis: From Naples, Luciano directs the drug trade through proxies and runs it out of a race track, so that dozens of associates are arrested over the years while he is never prosecuted.

predicaments.situation: a betrayer is exposed to the one betrayed
predicaments.basis: Giannini's letters to his handler pass through a mistress who has begun sleeping with Luciano, who reads them and learns his associate is informing.

predicaments.situation: a leader punishes the one he depends on
predicaments.basis: When Giannini fails to produce what he wants, Siragusa lets his own informant sit a year in an Italian jail, then sends him back to testify, where he is assassinated first.

predicaments.situation: a hunter is called off by his side
predicaments.basis: Siragusa's superiors order the investigation stopped and deny his accusation that they are protecting Dewey, who he says commuted Luciano for a bribe.

relatives.title: Z
relatives.shares: an investigator dismantled from above once the findings reach the wrong names

relatives.title: Chinatown
relatives.shares: an investigation that arrives at a power the investigator is not permitted to touch

relatives.title: Infernal Affairs
relatives.shares: an informer whose messages are read by the man he is informing on

relatives.title: Serpico
relatives.shares: an officer who accuses his own institution of covering for the people he is chasing

relatives.title: The Battle of Algiers
relatives.shares: a network built so that the men who can be arrested never know the man who cannot

films.title: The Merchant of Four Seasons
films.engine: Hans's family decided long ago that he is the failure of the household, and every job, marriage and reconciliation he attempts is measured against that verdict. After his heart gives out he hires a stronger man to push the fruit cart; the business does better than it ever did under him, his wife and his friend run it between them, and he sits watching his own life carry on without any need for him in it.

predicaments.situation: a child is judged unworthy by his family
predicaments.basis: Hans's mother greets his return from the Foreign Legion by saying the good die young, forbade him the trade he wanted, and with his sister and brother-in-law agrees he has always been good for nothing; only his student sister Anna says he was never given a chance.

roles.judging: his mother, Heidi and her husband

predicaments.situation: a wife flees the man she married
predicaments.basis: After Hans comes home drunk and beats Irmgard in front of their daughter, she takes Renate to his family and telephones a lawyer for a divorce.

predicaments.situation: a betrayer ruins the only possible witness
predicaments.basis: Irmgard, having slept with Anzell while Hans was in hospital, talks him into overcharging customers knowing Hans will catch him, and he is fired shouting that she tricked him.

predicaments.situation: a man returns to the love he lost
predicaments.basis: Hans goes back to the woman he once courted with roses, who refused him because her parents would not let her marry a fruit peddler; she undresses for him and he leaves.

predicaments.situation: a man is replaced inside his own home
predicaments.basis: Harry, taken on out of friendship, pushes the cart better than Hans ever did, moves in, makes the business profitable, and after the funeral stays on with Irmgard.

predicaments.situation: a man arranges his own death deliberately
predicaments.basis: Told that alcohol will kill his damaged heart, Hans sits down at a dinner with his wife and friends and drinks dozens of shots until it does.

relatives.title: The Servant
relatives.shares: a man brought into the household to work who ends up occupying the life of the one who hired him

relatives.title: Death of a Salesman
relatives.shares: a man measured all his life against his family's verdict on what he is worth

relatives.title: Umberto D.
relatives.shares: a man who discovers that the world he lives in continues perfectly well without him

relatives.title: Make Way for Tomorrow
relatives.shares: a family that has quietly decided which of its members are a burden

relatives.title: Leave Her to Heaven
relatives.shares: a wife who engineers another person's disgrace to keep her own secret buried

films.title: The Hellbenders
films.engine: Jonas refuses to accept that the war ended, and conscripts his three sons into carrying stolen banknotes across country hidden in a coffin, which requires a woman off the street to pose as the dead officer's widow. The scheme survives every stranger who wants the coffin opened; what it does not survive is that his sons want the money for themselves and the hired widow wants free of him.

predicaments.situation: a father drags his sons into his obsession
predicaments.basis: Jonas enlists Ben, Nat and Jeff in massacring a Union payroll escort and hauling the loot across country to fund a reborn Confederate army.

predicaments.situation: a man refuses to accept his side lost
predicaments.basis: Years after the surrender Jonas is still commanding as a colonel of a regiment that no longer exists, planning to reorganise and defeat the Union.

predicaments.situation: a stranger is paid to play the mourner
predicaments.basis: After the drunk Kitty is killed trying a double-cross, Ben recruits Claire, a saloon hostess and gambler, to impersonate the widow of the dead Captain Allen for anyone who stops the wagon.

predicaments.situation: a leader punishes the one he depends on
predicaments.basis: Claire has just talked a posse and a whole town's memorial service out of opening the coffin, and Jonas whips her and leaves her out in the storm for arranging its burial, so that she nearly dies of pneumonia.

predicaments.situation: a son turns against his father's cause
predicaments.basis: Ben, in love with Claire, denounces the family's fanaticism and offers the Indians the entire contents of the coffin to settle Jeff's crime.

predicaments.situation: brothers turn on each other over a prize
predicaments.basis: Nat and Jeff shoot each other arguing over the money, catching Ben in the crossfire, and the coffin Jonas dies beside turns out to hold a bandit chief instead.

relatives.title: Kagemusha
relatives.shares: a nobody recruited to impersonate a dead figure so that a cause can keep moving

relatives.title: The Treasure of the Sierra Madre
relatives.shares: companions who destroy each other over the haul they were carrying together

relatives.title: Ran
relatives.shares: a father whose refusal to relinquish his war consumes his three sons

relatives.title: The Searchers
relatives.shares: an obsession dragged across a continent, with the family conscripted into it

relatives.title: Sanjuro
relatives.shares: a party moving contraband under a respectable pretext that every checkpoint nearly opens

films.title: Un flic
films.engine: Edouard and Simon greet each other like old acquaintances in Simon's club and sleep with the same woman, both knowing it; the rest of the film is Edouard working steadily up the chain of Simon's crew until only Simon is left. Nobody is surprised by any of it — cornered men here kill themselves rather than be taken, and the last one walks out empty-handed toward a gun already drawn.

predicaments.situation: a hunter knows his quarry as a friend
predicaments.basis: Commissaire Coleman visits Simon's nightclub after hours, plays the piano there and greets Simon on his return from the bank robbery he has just committed.

predicaments.situation: two men on opposite sides share a woman
predicaments.basis: Cathy is Simon's girlfriend and meets Edouard in hotel rooms; Edouard works out that Simon has known about it all along, and she watches from her car as Edouard shoots him.

predicaments.situation: a wounded companion is killed for safety
predicaments.basis: With the press reporting an injured robber and the clinic refusing to release him, Simon sends Cathy in disguised as a nurse to put air into Marc's drip.

predicaments.situation: a leader punishes the one he depends on
predicaments.basis: When the heroin is not recovered at Bayonne, Edouard berates and slaps Gaby, the informant whose tips his work runs on.

predicaments.situation: a betrayer is exposed to the one betrayed
predicaments.basis: Edouard breaks Louis into naming Simon and Paul, then tells Simon to his face that Louis admitted knowing him.

predicaments.situation: a man arranges his own death deliberately
predicaments.basis: Paul shoots himself in the head as the police come through his door, and Simon, carrying no gun, reaches inside his coat in front of Edouard's drawn weapon.

relatives.title: Heat
relatives.shares: a policeman and a thief who recognise each other as equals and still finish it with a gun

relatives.title: The Big Combo
relatives.shares: a detective and the criminal he is chasing bound together through the same woman

relatives.title: Stray Dog
relatives.shares: a policeman whose pursuit turns into identification with the man he is hunting

relatives.title: Infernal Affairs
relatives.shares: an arrest that comes from a chain of men naming each other rather than from evidence

relatives.title: Gun Crazy
relatives.shares: a cornered pair for whom capture is never one of the available endings

films.title: Tidal Wave
films.engine: A scientist works out that the ground under his country is giving way, and cannot get anyone to act on it until three million people are already dead. What follows is not a rescue but a negotiation: how many of a people can be placed inside other people's countries before the land they came from is gone, and whether what is left of them stays a people at all. The lovers at the centre are simply two of the many who do not get out together.

predicaments.situation: a warning is not believed in time
predicaments.basis: Tadokoro's finding that the Japanese archipelago is being pulled into the Japan Trench is rejected as alarmist by the officials he briefs, until the Tokyo earthquake kills three million.

predicaments.situation: a home must be abandoned to survive
predicaments.basis: Plan D2 requires evacuating the entire population off the islands, and only 2.8 million leave in the first two months while sixty-three million remain as the coasts go under.

predicaments.situation: one man decides the fate of many
predicaments.basis: Yamamoto, advised by Watari and Tadokoro, weighs three futures for the people — a new country somewhere, dispersal into other nations, or passive acceptance of the end.

predicaments.situation: two lovers are parted by a common catastrophe
predicaments.basis: Onodera plans to marry Reiko and join her in Geneva, but a new earthquake and the eruption of Mount Fuji separate them; she ends on a Swiss train, he in an American boxcar.

predicaments.situation: someone chooses to stay behind and die
predicaments.basis: Tadokoro tells the dying Watari and Yamamoto that he will remain on the islands until the end rather than be evacuated.

relatives.title: When Worlds Collide
relatives.shares: a population must be lifted off a doomed world and almost none of it can go

relatives.title: The Emigrants
relatives.shares: a people leave the land they come from permanently and are scattered into other people's countries

relatives.title: Contagion
relatives.shares: technical warning outrunning what officials are willing to act on until the bodies arrive

relatives.title: Children of Men
relatives.shares: nations deciding how many of the displaced they will admit

relatives.title: Threads
relatives.shares: a state's orderly plans meeting a catastrophe on a scale no administration can carry

films.title: Trip to Vienna
films.engine: Two wives in a town emptied of men take money their husbands extorted from their Jewish neighbours and spend it chasing the glamour the war advertised. They are swindled, they take it back by force, and then, with a capital charge closing on them, they find they can survive by moving the punishment onto a man who declined to help — which works, and kills him, and quietly finishes their friendship.

predicaments.situation: the women are left behind by departing men
predicaments.basis: In 1943 nearly every man of the small German town is at the front, leaving Toni and Marga with a party official, an aunt, and daydreams of decorated soldiers on leave.

predicaments.situation: desire is pursued outside an intact marriage
predicaments.basis: With her husband away Toni carries on a joyless affair with Fred Scheuermann, and both women travel to Vienna partly to find attractive soldiers to sleep with.

predicaments.situation: a stranger keeps what was entrusted to him
predicaments.basis: On the train Mariu Moltenau presents himself as a Romanian officer who can convert their Reichsmark into valuables; Toni hands him most of the money and he never opens his door again.

predicaments.situation: help is refused at the moment of need
predicaments.basis: With the illegal pig slaughter exposed, the aunt jailed and Marga about to be indicted, Toni asks her lover Fred to intervene and he refuses.

predicaments.situation: punishment for one is deflected onto another
predicaments.basis: The women plant meat in Fred's office and garden and stage a rape so the charge lands on him; the investigator, doubting the evidence, sends him to the Eastern Front, where he is killed.

predicaments.situation: two friends turn on each other afterward
predicaments.basis: A year on, the partnership that survived the swindle and the frame-up breaks over the hidden car, which Marga smashes; they only nod to each other again on the street at the war's end.

relatives.title: Le Corbeau
relatives.shares: a small wartime town where an accusation is the available weapon and a man is destroyed by one that is not true

relatives.title: The Marriage of Maria Braun
relatives.shares: a woman surviving a war and its aftermath through transactions with whichever men are still available

relatives.title: Thelma & Louise
relatives.shares: two friends whose outing turns into a crime that binds them and then strains the friendship past repair

relatives.title: The Third Man
relatives.shares: a charming acquaintance in Vienna whose promised goods turn out to be a fraud on the people who trusted him

films.title: Last Tango in Paris
films.engine: A man whose wife has just killed herself rents an empty apartment and makes a bargain with a young woman he meets there: no names, no histories, nothing but the body. It holds only while he keeps his own rule. The moment he tells her his life and asks for her name, she wants nothing more to do with him — and his refusal to let her go turns the anonymity he invented into the story she will tell the police.

predicaments.situation: two people agree to remain strangers
predicaments.basis: Paul insists that he and Jeanne exchange no personal information and not even given names inside the rented apartment, over her objection.

predicaments.situation: a woman is forced by a familiar man
predicaments.basis: Paul anally rapes Jeanne in the apartment using butter as lubricant; she says she tries to leave him afterwards and cannot bring herself to.

predicaments.situation: a rule is broken by its own maker
predicaments.basis: After his wife's viewing Paul seeks Jeanne out, tells her of the suicide and his whole life story in a tango bar, and asks to know her name.

predicaments.situation: someone will not accept that it is over
predicaments.basis: Jeanne tells Paul she does not want to see him again and threatens to call the police; he chases her through the streets and forces his way into her mother's apartment.

predicaments.situation: a killing is rehearsed into a different story
predicaments.basis: Having shot Paul on the balcony, Jeanne mutters to herself that he was a stranger who tried to rape her and that she did not know who he was.

relatives.title: In the Realm of the Senses
relatives.shares: two people withdrawing into a room where only the body is admitted, ending in one of them killing the other

relatives.title: Vertigo
relatives.shares: a man in mourning who imposes a shape on a woman and pursues her past the point of her refusal

relatives.title: The Piano Teacher
relatives.shares: an arrangement designed to keep the person out of the sex, collapsing when one party asks to be known

relatives.title: Fatal Attraction
relatives.shares: an affair set up as anonymous by one party, who then cannot accept being told it is finished

films.title: Is Paris Burning?
films.engine: A general is handed a city and an order to leave nothing of it, by a man who picked him precisely because he would obey. Everyone else in the film — two rival resistance factions, a neutral consul, an army planning to drive past — acts on the assumption that the order will be carried out, and spends themselves trying to make it impossible, while the one man who could give it quietly never does.

predicaments.situation: an order is quietly not carried out
predicaments.basis: Hitler appoints Choltitz military governor believing he will demolish Paris; Choltitz, judging him insane and the war lost, lets the explosives be laid but issues no destruction order and surrenders.

predicaments.situation: one man decides the fate of many
predicaments.basis: The survival of the city, its landmarks and the population fighting in its streets rests entirely on what Choltitz does with a standing order nobody else knows he is withholding.

predicaments.situation: two factions of one side disagree on timing
predicaments.basis: The Gaullists under Chaban-Delmas want to stay hidden until the Allies come, while Rol-Tanguy's communists start a general uprising that forces the Gaullists into the open with them.

predicaments.situation: help is asked of those passing by
predicaments.basis: A resistance messenger crosses to the Americans to tell them the landmarks are mined and to beg for support so the rising is not crushed as Warsaw's was.

predicaments.situation: a man's family answers for his disobedience
predicaments.basis: Having decided to surrender rather than burn the city, Choltitz telephones German high command to ask that his family not suffer for it.

relatives.title: Kanal
relatives.shares: a city rising begun in the hope of outside support that does not arrive in time

relatives.title: The Battle of Algiers
relatives.shares: an occupied city where rival wings of a resistance disagree over when the population should be exposed

relatives.title: The Bridge on the River Kwai
relatives.shares: a commander whose private judgement about what should be destroyed overrides the orders he holds

relatives.title: Downfall
relatives.shares: subordinates weighing an insane order from a leadership that has already lost the war

relatives.title: Rome, Open City
relatives.shares: an occupied city whose fate turns on which individuals will and will not do what they are told

films.title: Love in the Afternoon
films.engine: A man who genuinely loves his wife misses the part of life before her — the chasing, the anticipation — and finds a way to have it without the act: an old acquaintance from his past who wants his afternoons rather than his bed. The film is about how long that arrangement can be held at exactly that distance, what he can say to her that he cannot say at home, and the small domestic reflex that finally sends him back.

predicaments.situation: desire is pursued outside an intact marriage
predicaments.basis: Frédéric, happily married to Hélène with a second child coming, spends his days imagining the women he was once free to chase and his afternoons with Chloé.

predicaments.situation: closeness is kept just short of consummation
predicaments.basis: Frédéric enjoys an attractive companion without the guilt of adultery, and Chloé has a man who does whatever she wants without needing sex from her.

predicaments.situation: someone asks to be given a child
predicaments.basis: Chloé, deciding a child would give her aimless life focus and wanting no marriage, tells Frédéric that he will be the father, treating his existing family as beside the point.

predicaments.situation: a man turns back at the final moment
predicaments.basis: Undressing in Chloé's flat after towelling her dry, Frédéric catches his reflection with his head through the turtleneck, remembers a game with his daughter, and slips out without a word.

predicaments.situation: two people can no longer speak plainly together
predicaments.basis: Frédéric talks with Chloé about things he finds himself unable to raise with Hélène; when he comes home the two of them grope for words until Hélène breaks down crying.

relatives.title: Brief Encounter
relatives.shares: an attachment carried right up to the act and then relinquished, the person going home to the marriage

relatives.title: In the Mood for Love
relatives.shares: two people who keep the intimacy and deliberately refuse the consummation

relatives.title: Eyes Wide Shut
relatives.shares: a married man's drift through near-infidelities that returns him, shaken, to his wife

relatives.title: The Lunchbox
relatives.shares: a confidant outside the marriage who receives what the spouse cannot be told

films.title: Loving Couples
films.engine: Three women arrive at the same maternity ward, all tied to one estate, all carrying children by men who are not the ones their circumstances assigned them. Working backwards through their lives, each was steered — by a father's death, by a payment, by what her class allowed — into a bed or a marriage she did not choose; then the war takes the men away and leaves the women holding the result.

predicaments.situation: marriage is arranged across a difference of class
predicaments.basis: Adèle's love for Daniel is broken off as a mésalliance and she is married to Tord, the tenant at Eka; the maid Agda is married to Stellan von Pahlen as a matter of convenience.

predicaments.situation: a marriage is paid for by a third person
predicaments.basis: Bernhard Landborg, who fathered Agda's child in the bushes at Ösa, secures the match by offering Stellan fifteen thousand kronor a year.

predicaments.situation: a household is impoverished by a death
predicaments.basis: Adèle's father dies and she falls from comfort to hawking candies through a string of humiliations; Angela is orphaned at her father's funeral and taken in by her aunt Petra.

predicaments.situation: a woman is forced by a familiar man
predicaments.basis: Teacher Bell tries to seduce Angela at the girls' boarding school, and an older man attempts to rape Agda during her childhood.

predicaments.situation: desire is pursued outside an intact marriage
predicaments.basis: Stellan plays erotic games with Mrs. Landborg at the midsummer party, and Petra, waiting at the station, sees the former lover who is now married with a son.

predicaments.situation: the women are left behind by departing men
predicaments.basis: War breaks out and the men of Eka go into military service and out of the women's daily lives, leaving the three of them to their pregnancies and Dr. Lewin's ward.

relatives.title: The Leopard
relatives.shares: marriages settled across a class line as an estate order gives way to a new era

relatives.title: Tess
relatives.shares: a girl of a fallen household preyed on by a man above her station and left carrying the result

relatives.title: The Rules of the Game
relatives.shares: a country house where nearly every desire runs outside the pairing it is supposed to belong to

relatives.title: Raise the Red Lantern
relatives.shares: women inside one household whose lives are wholly set by what the arrangement between men permits

relatives.title: The Go-Between
relatives.shares: a love that class forbids, yielding to the marriage the family requires

films.title: A Little Night Music
films.engine: A lawyer's second marriage has gone eleven months unconsummated: his teenage wife keeps saying soon, his son by his first wife is secretly in love with her, and the actress he left fourteen years ago has decided she wants him back. Everyone in the film is attached to the wrong person and half knows it, and a weekend at a country house forces all the mismatches into the same rooms until the pairs resort themselves.

predicaments.situation: a wife withholds herself from her husband
predicaments.basis: Anne, eighteen and married to Frederich for eleven months, has kept her virginity and keeps telling him she will be ready soon.

predicaments.situation: a former lover returns to claim him
predicaments.basis: Desiree, tired of touring in play after play, meets Frederich again fourteen years after their affair and has her mother invite the whole family to the country estate so she can take him back.

predicaments.situation: a young man wants his father's wife
predicaments.basis: Erich, studying for the church and only a year older than Anne, confesses to Fredericka that he loves his father's wife, runs out to kill himself over it, and is stopped by Anne.

predicaments.situation: a spouse flirts to make the other jealous
predicaments.basis: Charlotte courts Frederich openly across the dinner table to provoke Carl-Magnus, who has been keeping Desiree.

predicaments.situation: two men risk death over the same woman
predicaments.basis: Carl-Magnus challenges Frederich to a game of Russian roulette; Frederich draws the loaded chamber and the bullet only grazes his ear.

relatives.title: The Rules of the Game
relatives.shares: a weekend in the country collects every mismatched couple and rearranges them

relatives.title: Smiles of a Summer Night
relatives.shares: an old lover stages a country weekend to take a man back from his child bride

relatives.title: Ju Dou
relatives.shares: a young man's helpless desire for the young wife of the older man he lives under

relatives.title: Phaedra
relatives.shares: a stepson and his father's wife cannot survive wanting each other

relatives.title: The Awful Truth
relatives.shares: a spouse performs a flirtation in public purely to make the other jealous

films.title: The Cowboys
films.engine: An aging rancher who cannot find grown men to move his herd hires the local schoolboys instead, and across the drive becomes the father the job keeps requiring of him. When rustlers take the herd and one of them shoots him in the back while the boys stand by under his own order not to resist, the boys are left holding what he made of them — and they go and finish it.

predicaments.situation: a man makes children do a man's work
predicaments.basis: Wil Andersen, stripped of ranch hands by the gold rush, hires schoolboys off the local benches and trains them to rope, brand and drive cattle to South Dakota.

predicaments.situation: a child is sworn to silence by threat
predicaments.basis: Asa Watts catches Dan alone, lets him go, and promises to slit his throat if he tells Andersen the gang has been trailing the herd; Dan says nothing until the rustlers are already on the camp.

predicaments.situation: children watch their protector killed
predicaments.basis: Andersen tells the boys to be non-resistant, beats Watts in a fistfight, and is shot in the back as he walks away; the boys stay passive as instructed while the herd is taken.

predicaments.situation: children take up the killing of adults
predicaments.basis: After burying Andersen the boys break out the guns locked in the chuck wagon, and with Nightlinger's plan they knife three rustlers, ambush the rest, and drag Watts to death behind a spooked horse.

predicaments.situation: the living settle a debt to the dead
predicaments.basis: With the money from the sold cattle the boys hire a stonemason to cut Andersen's name and "Beloved Husband and Father" and set the marker near where they buried him.

relatives.title: Red River
relatives.shares: an old cattleman's authority over the young men on his drive becomes the whole subject

relatives.title: True Grit
relatives.shares: a child assembles the means to kill the man who killed the father

relatives.title: Come and See
relatives.shares: a boy is handed adult violence to carry and is remade by it

relatives.title: Lord of the Flies
relatives.shares: boys with no adults left take up adult authority and killing

relatives.title: Sansho the Bailiff
relatives.shares: children must go on alone after the one protecting them is taken

films.title: Ningen
films.engine: Four men on a ship that can no longer steer run out of water and then out of food, and two of them decide the boy among them is the meal. The old man who has kept them alive by prayer and by rationing keeps them alive a second time with a vision he invents — and when a real ship appears exactly as he promised, the two who did the killing cannot go on living inside the rescue.

predicaments.situation: a man rations the little that is left
predicaments.basis: Kamegoro prays to Kompira and doles out the remaining food and water, while Hachizo and Gorosuke rebel and insist on eating their whole share at once.

predicaments.situation: the starving kill the weakest among them
predicaments.basis: After weeks without food Hachizo and Gorosuke lure Sankichi with the promise of something to eat and kill him with an axe.

predicaments.situation: an old man fails to protect a boy
predicaments.basis: Sankichi is the grandson who kept faith with Kamegoro's rationing and prayers; Kamegoro comes looking for him too late, fights the weakened Hachizo, and buries the boy at sea.

predicaments.situation: a lie is told to keep people alive
predicaments.basis: Kamegoro invents a second vision in which Kompira has blown a ship from San Francisco off course toward them, and such a ship then appears.

predicaments.situation: the killers cannot live with what they did
predicaments.basis: Safe on the deck of the rescuing ship, Gorosuke dances himself into a cargo hold and dies and Hachizo kills himself, leaving Kamegoro the only survivor.

relatives.title: Lifeboat
relatives.shares: survivors adrift ration the last of everything and turn on one of their own

relatives.title: Society of the Snow
relatives.shares: starving survivors of a wreck do the thing they swore they would not do to the dead

relatives.title: Fires on the Plain
relatives.shares: hunger brings men to the point of eating each other and unmakes them

relatives.title: In the Heart of the Sea
relatives.shares: a boat's crew adrift decides which of them will be consumed

relatives.title: Life Is Beautiful
relatives.shares: a man invents a story and holds to it so the one in his care will survive

films.title: Exorcist II: The Heretic
films.engine: A priest whose own attempt at an exorcism ended with the woman burning to death is sent to clear the name of the dead colleague the Church wants to condemn — and the only witness is the girl that colleague died freeing. Everyone wants her opened up: her doctor wants the buried memory, the priest wants the death explained, and the thing that had her wants back in and offers him power to help it. Her ability to reach into other people is a symptom to the clinic and the beginning of a new species to the dead man.

predicaments.situation: an institution disowns the man it sent
predicaments.basis: The Cardinal tells Lamont that Merrin faces posthumous heresy charges over his writings, because Church authorities are modernising and would rather not concede that Satan exists.

predicaments.situation: a survivor is pressed to remember what happened
predicaments.basis: Regan says she remembers nothing of Washington; Dr Tuskin believes the memory is repressed and hypnotises her through a brainwave synchroniser, and Lamont couples himself to the same device to reach the night Merrin died.

predicaments.situation: a doubter is offered power for his allegiance
predicaments.basis: Pazuzu appears to the faltering Lamont as a double of Regan and offers him unlimited power; he gives in before the real Regan pulls him back and he tears the double apart.

predicaments.situation: the ones able to heal are hunted
predicaments.basis: Lamont learns that Pazuzu goes after people with psychic healing power — the woman who claimed to heal the sick, the boy Kokumo in Africa, and now Regan.

predicaments.situation: a gift is mistaken for a sickness
predicaments.basis: Regan reaches into an autistic girl's mind and gets her to speak; the clinic staff treat it as a case to be studied while Merrin's circle held such powers to be a spiritual gift coming to everyone.

relatives.title: Spellbound
relatives.shares: a clinician unlocks a patient's buried memory and is pulled inside it

relatives.title: Carrie
relatives.shares: a girl's power is read by everyone around her as an illness

relatives.title: Ordet
relatives.shares: a congregation disowns the man whose faith is taken literally

relatives.title: The Devils
relatives.shares: an institution condemns its own priest rather than admit what he says is happening

relatives.title: Diary of a Country Priest
relatives.shares: a priest's faith fails at exactly the point his work requires it

films.title: Liza
films.engine: A man has walked out on his wife and children to live alone on an empty island with his dog, and a woman who wants to be attended to the way he attends to that animal drowns it and takes its place, on all fours, by mutual agreement. The arrangement survives his family calling him home; what it may not survive is the island itself, once the sea takes their only boat and the fishing will not feed two.

predicaments.situation: a stranger will not leave the solitary alone
predicaments.basis: Liza has herself put ashore on Giorgio's uninhabited island after a row with Ludwig and the friends she is sailing with, and returns to him after he ferries her back to the mainland.

predicaments.situation: a woman kills what her lover loves more
predicaments.basis: Finding that Giorgio wants her as a lover but would rather talk to his dog Melampo, Liza makes the animal swim until it drowns of exhaustion.

predicaments.situation: one lover consents to be owned by another
predicaments.basis: Liza takes the dead dog's place, playing the animal to Giorgio's master, and he accepts the game of dominance and submission.

predicaments.situation: a deserted family calls the man back
predicaments.basis: Giorgio's teenage son comes to tell him his mother has attempted suicide, and he leaves the island for Paris and the bourgeois life he had abandoned, asking Liza to wait.

predicaments.situation: two people cut themselves off from everyone else
predicaments.basis: Liza follows him to the city and talks him back to the island for a life with no one else in it; the sea then carries off their inflatable boat and they face starvation with only a patched-up wartime plane to try.

relatives.title: Swept Away
relatives.shares: two people stranded alone on an island fall into an owner-and-owned arrangement

relatives.title: The Night Porter
relatives.shares: a pair rebuild a private master-and-animal bond and shut out the world until it starves them

relatives.title: Secretary
relatives.shares: submission entered freely becomes the actual terms of a relationship

relatives.title: Woman in the Dunes
relatives.shares: a man and a woman sealed off from everyone else build a life out of the enclosure

relatives.title: Fatal Attraction
relatives.shares: a lover destroys an animal to be felt by the person who will not attend to her

films.title: Zatoichi and the Chest of Gold
films.engine: A blind swordsman comes to a village to make peace at the grave of a man he killed, and arrives just as the tax money eighteen drought-starved villages have scraped together is ambushed on the road. The villagers blame him, so he promises to bring it back — and finds that the official the money was owed to arranged the robbery and is now demanding the sum a second time, while the dead man's sister follows him unsure whether she wants him killed or wants his help.

predicaments.situation: the living settle a debt to the dead
predicaments.basis: Ichi travels to Itakura to pay respects at the grave of a man he killed two years earlier, is trailed the whole film by the man's sister Chiyo, and finally hands over his gambling winnings so her brother can have a proper headstone.

predicaments.situation: a helper is blamed for the harm done
predicaments.basis: After Ichi holds off the robbers at the foot of the hill, the village men accost him as the cause of the theft, and he promises to find the gold.

predicaments.situation: the one entrusted with it took it himself
predicaments.basis: Intendant Gundayu, to whom the eighteen villages of Usui county owed 1,000 Ryo, turns out to have arranged the ambush with the whip-wielding Jushiro and taken the gold.

predicaments.situation: the poor are made to pay twice
predicaments.basis: After three years of drought and near famine, Gundayu rejects the headman's plea for leniency, demands the tax again within ten days, and orders four village men executed at dawn.

predicaments.situation: a leader is answerable for his men's crimes
predicaments.basis: Ichi climbs Mt Akagi to ask the outlaw Chuji why he stole the money; two of his troupe confess to having gone rogue and beg to be killed, and Chuji gives up the bandit life.

relatives.title: Yojimbo
relatives.shares: a wandering swordsman finds that the men holding the town are the ones bleeding it

relatives.title: Seven Samurai
relatives.shares: farmers with nothing left are stripped again and an outsider stands between them and it

relatives.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
relatives.shares: the official who collects the tax is the man stealing it

relatives.title: Unforgiven
relatives.shares: a killer comes back to settle what he owes the people he made

films.title: Il gatto
films.engine: A brother and sister who own a decaying building can only sell it if every tenant is gone, so they turn the private life of each person under their roof into a reason to remove them. When their cat dies, the hunt for who killed it becomes the pretext for opening every door in the building, and each secret they uncover — a brothel, a drug stash, a corpse, a hidden past — clears another apartment. They win the building empty and lose the sale to a single woman who walks back in.

predicaments.situation: people are driven from their home for profit
predicaments.basis: Amedeo and Ofelia Pegoraro are offered a billion lira for their apartment building on condition it holds no tenants, so they set about goading and evicting everyone in it.

predicaments.situation: private lives are searched for grounds to expel
predicaments.basis: The siblings spy on and raid apartments, exposing the Princess's brothel, the musicians' cocaine, Don Garofalo's bloodstains and Don Pezzolla's conduct, each discovery emptying another flat.

predicaments.situation: two who cannot part quarrel without end
predicaments.basis: The Pegoraro siblings fight constantly yet run the building, the cat, the spying and the scheme together as one inseparable pair.

predicaments.situation: a dead animal sets neighbors accusing one another
predicaments.basis: The siblings' cat is found dead and the investigation into who killed it becomes the instrument by which every tenant is suspected, denounced and removed.

predicaments.situation: a vague accusation lands on a guilty conscience
